topics.purpose: Keeps the System Security Plan accurate: boundary, systems, external service providers and how each requirement is implemented.
always: Confirm the boundary diagram and system inventory match the environment
Confirm each requirement's implementation statement is current
Record external service providers and their shared responsibilities

topics.purpose: Tracks every open deficiency to closure with an owner and milestone dates.
always: Update each open item's status, owner and milestone dates
Close items only with evidence of remediation
Add new deficiencies from assessments and reviews

topics.purpose: Confirms penetration testing is planned and performed on schedule, and that findings are remediated and retested.
generic: Obtain the latest penetration test report
always: Confirm findings are remediated or risk-accepted, with retest results recorded
Confirm the scope covers current external IP addresses and sites
client: Client approves the test scope and window

topics.purpose: Confirms the secure development process and third-party component management are followed.
generic: Review the secure development process and its recent exceptions
Review the third-party component inventory and its vulnerability findings

gov: Secure development process reviewed; exceptions approved

topics.purpose: Confirms endpoint protections are deployed and current: anti-malware, host firewalls, session locking, DNS filtering and autorun controls.
generic: Confirm anti-malware is installed and updating on every endpoint
Confirm host firewalls and session locking are enforced
Confirm DNS filtering applies to every device
always: Confirm exclusions and disabled protections are documented and approved

gov: Exclusions and disabled protections have documented approval

topics.purpose: Confirms network infrastructure is securely managed, segmented and monitored.
generic: Obtain the firewall and network device list with firmware status
Confirm network alerts and logs are monitored
always: Confirm segmentation and remote access paths match the documented architecture

gov: Network architecture documentation reviewed and updated (CIS 12.4: at least annually and after relevant significant enterprise changes)
Network architecture documentation reviewed and updated under the applicable requirements and organizational plan

topics.purpose: Keeps the enterprise asset inventory complete and current, and confirms unauthorized assets are dealt with.
generic: Obtain a dated export from the inventory system of record
Compare the inventory against a second source (DHCP, MDM, firewall or scanner) and investigate unknown devices
always: Confirm the inventory covers end-user, mobile, server, network, IoT, virtual, cloud and remote assets; name the source for anything the main tool doesn't see
Confirm unauthorized assets found since the last review were removed, denied or quarantined
client: Confirm owner, department and approved-to-connect for assets added since the last review
Updated inventory fields or client confirmation
Client confirms owner, department and approved-to-connect for assets added since the last review

topics.purpose: Keeps the software inventory current and confirms only authorized, supported software is in use.
generic: List unsupported or end-of-life software found
always: Confirm each unsupported item is removed or has a documented exception with mitigating controls
Confirm unauthorized software was removed or approved
Confirm browsers, email clients and network infrastructure firmware are on supported versions
client: Confirm business purpose for applications added since the last review

gov: Unsupported software has a documented, client-approved exception or a removal date
client: Client confirms business purpose for applications added since the last review

topics.purpose: Confirms the documented data management process is current and its parts operate: data inventory, access permissions, retention, disposal and encryption.
generic: Confirm device encryption is enabled on end-user devices
always: Review the data management process and update it for changes (at least annually)
Confirm access permissions on locations holding sensitive data follow need-to-know
Confirm disposal records for retired devices and media
client: Confirm the data inventory, data owners and retention periods

gov: Data management process reviewed and updated (CIS 3.1: at least annually and after relevant significant enterprise changes)
Data management process reviewed and updated under the applicable requirements and organizational plan
client: Client confirms the data inventory, data owners and retention periods

topics.purpose: Confirms documented secure configuration processes exist for enterprise assets and network infrastructure and are kept current.
generic: Obtain the current configuration standards or baselines
always: Review and update the secure configuration process for enterprise assets (at least annually or after significant change)
Review and update the secure configuration process for network infrastructure
Confirm deviations from the baseline are recorded and approved
client: Client approves exceptions to the baseline

gov: Secure configuration processes for enterprise assets and network infrastructure reviewed and updated (CIS 4.1 and 4.2: at least annually and after relevant significant enterprise changes)
Secure configuration process reviewed and updated under the applicable requirements and organizational plan
client: Client approved any exceptions to the baseline

topics.purpose: Confirms accounts are inventoried and authorized, dormant accounts are disabled, admin access is separated and MFA is enforced.
generic: Export every account with name, username, department and start/end dates
Disable or remove dormant accounts per the framework threshold
always: Confirm administrator accounts are dedicated and separate from daily-use accounts
Confirm MFA for externally exposed applications, remote access and administrative access
Sample access-granting and access-revoking tickets since the last review
client: Client approver validates the account list: who should have access
Client approver validated the account list
Client’s access-granting and revocation process, including HR notice, is documented

topics.purpose: Confirms the vulnerability management process runs: operating systems and applications are patched on schedule and found vulnerabilities are remediated by risk.
generic: Obtain OS and application patch compliance reports
Obtain the latest vulnerability scan results
always: For CIS 7.1, review vulnerability-management documentation annually and after relevant significant changes; for CIS 7.2, review the risk-based remediation process at least monthly. Other programs use their applicable requirements and plan.
Confirm overdue patches and high-risk findings have a remediation plan or a documented exception
client: Client approves risk acceptance for anything not remediated
Client approved risk acceptance for anything not remediated

topics.purpose: Confirms audit logging is defined, enabled, stored with enough capacity and retention, and reviewed.
generic: Confirm logging is enabled on servers, firewalls and Microsoft 365
Confirm log retention meets the framework requirement
always: Review and update the audit log management process (at least annually)
Confirm logs are reviewed and alerts triaged; sample recent escalations

gov: Audit log management process reviewed and updated (CIS 8.1: at least annually and after relevant significant enterprise changes)
Audit log management process reviewed and updated under the applicable requirements and organizational plan

topics.purpose: Confirms incident handling roles, contacts and the reporting process are current, and the response capability is tested where required.
always: Confirm the person who manages incident handling, and a backup, are designated
Update the incident contact list both ways: client contacts and iVenture contacts
Confirm the workforce knows how to report an incident
Run or schedule the incident response exercise where the framework requires one
client: Client confirms its decision-maker and notification contacts (insurer, legal counsel, regulators)

topics.purpose: Reviews the awareness program and workforce training against applicable scoped requirements and the organizational plan.
generic: Obtain training-completion evidence; phishing results are optional organizational validation.
always: For CIS 14.1, update awareness content annually and after relevant significant changes. Other programs follow their applicable requirements and plan.
Confirm the applicable scoped awareness topics using the linked source requirements; one universal topic list does not cover every framework.
client: Client follows up with users who haven't completed training
For CIS 14.1, train new hires at hire and the workforce at least annually. Other programs follow their applicable timing requirements and plan.

topics.purpose: Confirms the service provider inventory is complete and current, providers are classified, and the agreements regulated data needs are in place.
always: Update the service provider inventory: add new providers, retire old ones, confirm contacts
Apply the enterprise provider-assessment policy and risk/classification. Assurance reports or questionnaires are options, not a universal CIS IG1 inventory requirement.
Confirm required agreements (BAA, DPA, confidentiality terms) are in place where regulated data is shared
client: Client confirms non-IT providers that handle company data

topics.purpose: Confirms the risk assessment is current and drives treatment decisions.
always: Confirm the assessment scope covers every system holding regulated or sensitive data
Update threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood and impact
Confirm each significant risk has a treatment decision and an owner
client: Client leadership reviews and accepts residual risk

topics.purpose: Confirms security policies and procedures are current, approved, available to the people who need them and retained as required.
always: Review each policy for changes in practice or requirements
Record approvals and new version numbers
Confirm documentation is retained for the period the framework requires (HIPAA: six years)

topics.purpose: Confirms physical access to facilities and systems is limited, logged and reviewed.
client: Review physical access logs and the badge holder list
Confirm visitors are escorted and logged

topics.purpose: Confirms media is sanitized or destroyed before disposal or reuse, and marked where required.
always: Obtain sanitization or destruction records for the period
Confirm media marking where the framework requires it

topics.purpose: Periodically evaluates whether security controls still meet the framework and remain effective.
always: Re-assess the requirements due for review in GoverNara

topics.purpose: Reviews the cybersecurity strategy and the current and target profile against outcomes.
always: Compare the current profile with the target

topics.purpose: Confirms the data recovery process is current, backups run for in-scope systems, recovery data is protected and an isolated copy exists, and recovery is tested where required.
generic: Obtain backup job reports for every in-scope system
For applicable CIS 11.4, verify an isolated recovery instance; offline or immutable alone does not prove isolation. Other programs use their applicable recovery requirements.
always: For CIS 11.1, review recovery documentation annually and after relevant significant changes; check the separate operating/test requirements. Other programs follow their applicable plan.
Confirm a restore test was performed and recorded where the framework requires it
client: Client confirms which systems and data must be recoverable and the recovery expectations
Client confirmed which systems and data must be recoverable and the recovery expectations

record_guides.purpose: Keeps this risk's rating and treatment current. Every register risk is reviewed on its schedule.
steps: Confirm the risk is still relevant and its description is accurate
Check progress on the linked treatment actions
Record an acceptance or closure decision with a named approver, if applicable

record_guides.purpose: Confirms this provider is still needed, correctly classified and covered by current assurance and agreements.
steps: Confirm the provider is still in use and the business owner
Confirm services and data access are unchanged
Confirm assurance meets the organization-agreed freshness and coverage policy; a 12-month age or bridge letter is not a universal ISO/SOC deadline
Confirm contract, renewal and notice dates, and required agreements (BAA, DPA)

record_guides.purpose: Collects and reviews this provider's current security assurance.
steps: Obtain the current SOC 2 report, ISO 27001 certificate or completed questionnaire
Check the report period and any bridge letter
Review exceptions and complementary user entity controls that apply to the client

record_guides.purpose: Decides renewal before the notice date and confirms the security terms.
steps: Confirm security and data protection terms

record_guides.purpose: Confirms this AI system is still used as approved, with the agreed data limits and human review.
steps: Confirm the approved use is unchanged
Confirm what data is entered and that prohibited data is excluded
Confirm human review before important output is used
Check vendor terms on training, retention and data location
Record the approval decision and conditions

record_guides.purpose: Keeps this policy accurate, approved and communicated.
steps: Compare the policy with current practice and framework requirements
Update the version and obtain approval
